spec: DACS-4 §9.5.8 SB-1/SB-2 signed event identity and legacy replay

vectors.name: current-evm-log-index
vectors.note: a signed EVM log index selects the independently verified transfer

vectors.name: current-solana-instruction-index
vectors.note: a signed Solana instruction index selects the independently verified transfer

vectors.name: batched-evm-transfer-distinct-key
vectors.note: two matching transfers in one envelope remain distinct because the signed log indexes differ

vectors.name: same-event-second-job-rejected
vectors.note: SB-2 rejects the same verified event under a second jobId

vectors.name: current-event-index-missing
vectors.note: the current discriminator without its signed coordinate is malformed

vectors.name: current-event-index-negative
vectors.note: a negative signed coordinate is malformed and cannot mint a key

vectors.name: signed-index-ledger-mismatch
vectors.note: a valid signature cannot rescue an index that selects the wrong transfer

vectors.name: legacy-unambiguous-replay
vectors.note: one authenticated matching event permits a legacy event-level projection

vectors.name: legacy-ambiguous-replay
vectors.note: two authenticated matching events leave a legacy envelope reference ambiguous

vectors.name: legacy-out-of-band-index-not-authority
vectors.note: an unsigned caller index cannot disambiguate two matching legacy events

vectors.name: current-ledger-unavailable
vectors.note: unavailable authenticated ledger evidence never becomes pass or counterparty failure

vectors.name: current-x402-event
vectors.note: the signed x402 receipt fields and EVM event resolve to one event identity

vectors.name: signed-evidence-amount-ledger-mismatch
vectors.note: a valid evidence signature over 5 USDC cannot validate a 6 USDC ledger event

vectors.name: payment-anchor-job-mismatch
vectors.note: a valid evidence signature cannot bind the record to another job's PC-2 address

vectors.name: payment-anchor-rail-mismatch
vectors.note: the PC-2 rail segment must equal the authenticated agreement/phase rail

vectors.name: payment-anchor-phase-index-mismatch
vectors.note: the PC-2 phase index must equal the authenticated BundlePhaseEntry index

vectors.name: payment-anchor-cf4-encoded-rail
vectors.note: the complete PC-2 comparison uses the canonical CF-4-encoded rail segment

vectors.name: legacy-x402-unambiguous-replay
vectors.note: one authenticated receipt-bound transfer permits a legacy x402 event projection

vectors.name: legacy-x402-no-matching-event
vectors.note: a resolved legacy x402 transaction with no matching transfer fails

vectors.name: legacy-x402-ambiguous-replay
vectors.note: multiple authenticated matching transfers leave legacy x402 event identity indeterminate

vectors.name: legacy-x402-ledger-unavailable
vectors.note: unavailable authenticated ledger data leaves legacy x402 replay indeterminate

vectors.name: legacy-x402-receipt-hash-mismatch
vectors.note: the independently verified receipt hash must match the signed legacy x402 reference

vectors.name: legacy-x402-transaction-mismatch
vectors.note: the verified receipt transaction must match the signed legacy x402 transaction

vectors.name: legacy-x402-network-mismatch
vectors.note: the verified receipt network must match the signed legacy x402 chain

vectors.name: legacy-x402-out-of-band-index-not-authority
vectors.note: an unsigned index cannot disambiguate multiple legacy x402 transfers

vectors.name: event-discriminator-stripping
vectors.note: removing the new discriminator and coordinate after signing invalidates the evidence signature

vectors.name: cross-type-signature-replay
vectors.note: an EVM-event signature replayed over a Solana-instruction record is invalid

vectors.name: legacy-no-matching-event
vectors.note: a resolved legacy transaction with no matching settlement event fails
